Show a chart of India's GDP growth for the last 5 years
4:08 PM

Here's India's yearly GDP growth for the five years from FY 2020-21 to FY 2024-25. The country dropped 5.8% in the Covid year, then bounced back with 9.7% and 9.2% growth in FY 2021-22 and FY 2023-24. It cooled to 6.5% in FY 2024-25.

These are rounded figures from memory, after the government's revisions, so check them against the official release. I left out FY 2025-26 because I'm not sure of its final number.
